blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hand anthropometry supports protective-glove design, but existing measurement methods often require trained operators, specialized hardware, or manual landmarking. We present HandAnthro , which estimates 44 projected hand dimensions from a smartphone photograph of a palm-up hand on US letter-size paper. The pipeline reconstructs wrist-occluded paper boundaries for rectification, whitens non-hand pixels, and refines 41 anthropometry-specific landmarks from a fine-tuned You Only Look Once (YOLO) pose model using image-specific geometry and contours. Controlled evaluation comprised 720 captures from 45 held-out participants, each contributing 16 images across two smartphones, two backgrounds, two angles, and two nominal illumination settings. HandAnthro produced complete outputs for 704 captures (97.8%); among these, mean absolute error (MAE) was 3.80 3.80 mm per dimension against two trained operators’ caliper measurements. Regional MAEs were 2.48 2.48 mm for non-thumb fingers, 6.04 6.04 mm for thumbs, and 6.17 6.17 mm for palm and wrist. In a researcher-assisted mobile-app pilot, automated batch processing returned all 44 dimensions for 260 of 268 retained, researcher-screened firefighter images (97.0%). A descriptive, unpaired comparison with an independent national firefighter reference yielded a mean absolute difference of 2.40 2.40 mm across 28 sex-by-dimension group-mean contrasts. These results characterize controlled measurement performance and researcher-assisted field feasibility for future distributed hand-anthropometry studies.
blocks.zh: 手性人体测量学支持保护-格氏设计,但现有的测量方法往往需要经过训练的操作员,专门的硬件,或手动地标设计. 我们介绍HandAnthro, 从智能手机照片中, 输油管重建了手腕闭塞的纸质边框以进行矫正,白子非手像素,并用精细的You Only Look Once(YOLO)用图像特异的几何和轮廓对41个人类测量特异性的地标进行了精炼. 受控评价包括来自45名被搁置参与者的720次捕捉,每次提供16个图像,涉及两个智能手机、两个背景、两个角度和两个名义上的照明设置。 HandAnthro为704次捕获(97.8%)生产了完整的输出量;其中,平均绝对误差(MAE)为每维3.80毫米,而两个操作员经过训练的卡利佩测量值为3.80毫米。 区域MAE为非拇指2.482.48毫米,拇指6.046.04毫米,棕榈和手腕6.17毫米。 在研究人员协助的移动应用试点中,自动批量处理返回了所有44维的268个留存的260个,由研究人员筛选的消防员图像(97.0%). 与独立的国家消防员比较后发现,在28个按性别划分的群体-平均对比中,有2.402.40毫米的平均绝对差别。 这些成果是未来分布式手工测量研究的可控测量性能和研究人员协助的实地可行性的特征。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Acute occupational hand injuries account for more than one million US emergency-department visits annually, and protective gloves reduce their relative risk by about 60% ( Sorock et al. 2004a ; Sorock et al. 2004b ) . This protection depends on fit: poor fit compounds losses in dexterity, tactile sensitivity, and grip strength and reduces user acceptance ( Dianat, Haslegrave, and Stedmon 2012 ; Griffin et al. 2018b ) . Yet glove-sizing systems often rely on outdated or unrepresentative hand data ( Hsiao et al. 2015 ; Hsiao et al. 2026 ) . Large, current anthropometric samples are therefore valuable for glove and hand-tool design, but direct caliper measurement requires trained operators, manual photogrammetry requires work on each image, and three-dimensional (3D) approaches require scanners or calibrated multi-view hardware ( Griffin et al. 2018a ; Yu et al. 2013 ; Yang et al. 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 急性职业手伤每年占美国紧急部门访问人数的100多万,防护手套将相对风险减少约60%(Sorock等人,2004年a;Sorock等人,2004年b)。 这种保护取决于适配性:适配性差的化合物在柔和度,触觉敏感性,握力和降低用户接受度(Dianat, Haslegrave, and Stedmon 2012; Griffin等人, 2018b). 然而手套尺寸系统往往依赖过时或不具代表性的手数据(Hsiao等人,2015年;Hsiao等人,2026年). 因此,当前大型人体测量样本对于手套和手工具设计很有价值,但直接的卡路里测量需要经过训练的操作员,人工摄影测量需要每个图像的工作,三维(3D)方法需要扫描仪或校准的多视图硬件(Griffin等人,2018a); 余等编. 2013; 杨等2021).

blocks.en: Prior automated two-dimensional (2D) hand-measurement systems have typically relied on tightly controlled acquisition setups, such as flatbed scanners or calibrated industrial-camera rigs ( Han and Park 2016 ; Nguyen, Le, and La 2025 ) . HandAnthro instead uses a simple smartphone protocol in which a palm-up, finger-spread hand is photographed on a letter-size paper sheet. The workflow uses the sheet geometry to rectify the image and recover metric scale, then localizes the anatomical endpoints needed to compute 44 projected dimensions. By reducing on-site equipment requirements and enabling an automated image-to-measurement workflow without manual involvement, this design targets two major operational barriers to larger, geographically distributed occupational hand-anthropometry studies. First, the system must recover a reliable paper reference despite wrist occlusion and camera viewpoint variation. Second, it must accurately localize measurement endpoints on the true hand contour despite unpredictable shadow patterns around the hand boundary caused by variations in real-world illumination and capture conditions.
blocks.zh: 先前的自动二维(2D)手测量系统一般都依赖于严格控制的获取装置,如平板扫描仪或校准的工业-摄像机钻机(Han and Park 2016;Nguyen, Le, and La 2025). HandAnthro转而使用一个简单的智能手机协议,其中一张掌上型,手指型的手被拍到字母大小的纸板上. 工作流程使用工作表几何来修正图像并恢复度量尺度,然后将计算44个预测维度所需的解剖端点本地化. 通过减少现场设备需求,并使图像对测量工作流程自动化,而无需人工参与,这一设计针对的是更大、地理分布分布的手工测量职业研究的两大业务障碍。 首先,尽管手腕闭塞和相机视距不同,该系统必须恢复可靠的纸张参考。 第二,它必须准确确定真实手轮廓上的测量终点,尽管由于现实世界照明和捕捉条件的变化而导致手边的阴影模式无法预测。

blocks.en: HandAnthro addresses the first problem by reconstructing the occluded paper mask before quadrilateral detection. It addresses the second by whitening the non-hand pixels, fine-tuning a You Only Look Once (YOLO) pose architecture ( Jocher, Chaurasia, and Qiu 2023 ; Jocher and Qiu 2024 ) to predict anthropometry-specific landmarks, and refining those predictions with image-specific finger geometry and contour constraints. These stages automatically produce the protocol-defined projected measurements without participant-specific calibration.
blocks.zh: HandAnthro通过在四边形探测之前重建圆形纸面罩来解决第一个问题. 它通过将非手像素白化,微调一个You Only Look Once(YOLO)设置建筑(Jocher,Chaurasia,和Quu 2023;Jocher和Quu 2024),来预测人类测量的具体地标,并用图像特定的手指几何和轮廓限制来完善这些预测. 这些阶段在不针对参与者进行校准的情况下自动生成协议定义的预测测量.

blocks.en: We evaluate HandAnthro in two complementary studies. A controlled repeated-capture study quantifies perspective-rectification and end-to-end completion, caliper-referenced measurement accuracy, and sensitivity across the tested capture conditions. A separate researcher-assisted mobile-app field pilot evaluates completion outside the capture rig and compares sex-specific group means with corresponding hand-anthropometry summaries from an independent national firefighter cohort. Because the cohorts are independent, this comparison assesses population-level plausibility rather than individual-level measurement accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两项补充研究评估汉德安特罗. 受控的重复捕捉研究量化了透视-校正和端到端的完成,卡力参照测量精度,以及测试的捕捉条件的敏感性. 一个单独的由研究人员协助的移动应用程序实地试点对捕获平台外的完成情况进行评价,并将特定性别群体手段与一个独立的国家消防队的相应人工人体测量摘要进行比较。 由于组别是独立的,这一比较评估了人口层面的可信度,而不是个人层面的测量准确性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Classical hand anthropometry measures standardized dimensions directly with contact instruments such as calipers or rulers between predefined anatomical landmarks ( Gordon et al. 1989 ; Yu et al. 2013 ) . The resulting staffing and quality-control burden makes distributed collection operationally demanding, although it does not preclude large centrally organized surveys.
blocks.zh: 古典的手人类测量测量法直接用接触器如卡利珀斯或统治者在预先定义的解剖地标之间进行标准化维度(Gordon et al. 1989; Yu et al. 2013) (中文(简体) ). 由此产生的人员配置和质量控制负担使得分配的收集工作在业务上要求很高,尽管这并不排除中央组织的大规模调查。

blocks.en: Digital methods measure dimensions from 2D images or 3D surfaces. Controlled 2D studies compared software-derived hand dimensions with direct measurements, but used fixed camera geometry and interactive placement of calibration or measurement lines ( Habibi, Soury, and Zadeh 2013 ; Patel et al. 2018 ) . 2D and 3D scanning methods have likewise been compared with direct measurements for selected dimensions ( Li et al. 2008 ; Yu et al. 2013 ) . 3D acquisition commonly requires a scanner or calibrated multi-view system and additional landmarking ( Griffin et al. 2018b ; Yang et al. 2021 ) . Deep learning has also automated measurement extraction from a single 3D hand scan, although the input still depends on 3D sensing hardware ( Kaashki et al. 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 数字方法从2D图像或3D表面测量维度. 控制下的2D研究将软件衍生的手维与直接测量进行比较,但使用固定相机几何和交互定位的校准或测量线(Habibi, Soury,和Zadeh 2013;Patel等人,2018年) 2D和3D扫描方法也与选定维度的直接测量方法进行了类似比较(Li等人,2008年;Yu等人,2013年) 3D的获取通常需要扫描仪或校准的多视图系统以及额外的地标测量(Griffin等人,2013年)。 2018b; Yang 等人 2021 ). 深层学习也从单张3D手扫描中自动提取测量数据,虽然输入仍然依赖于3D感应硬件(Kaashki等人,2022年).

blocks.en: Prior automated 2D methods vary in acquisition requirements and measurement outputs. A freehand smartphone prototype estimated the length ratio between two fingers without scale ( Sandnes 2014 ) . A reference-square workflow automatically estimated finger lengths from four digital-camera images per participant ( Magno and Pabico 2013 ) . Systems reporting more dimensions have used more controlled acquisition: an enclosed flatbed-scanner system automatically derived 18 dimensions from one palmar scan ( Han and Park 2016 ) , whereas a calibrated industrial-camera system derived 24 parameters from 12 images covering six postures of each hand in a light-controlled box ( Nguyen, Le, and La 2025 ) . These systems demonstrate 2D automation but differ in output breadth, capture count, portability, environmental control, and use of dedicated rigs.
blocks.zh: 先前的自动二维方法在采购要求和计量产出方面各不相同。 一个自由手智能手机原型估计了两个手指之间没有尺度的长度比(Sandnes 2014 . 参考-平面工作流程从每个参与者四个数码相机图像自动估计指长(Magno和Pabico,2013年)。 报告更多维度的系统使用了更受控制的获取:一个封闭的平板扫描系统通过一次棕榈树扫描(Han and Park 2016)自动生成18维度,而经过校准的工业相机系统则从12幅图像中得出24个参数,这些图像覆盖了轻控制箱中每只手的6个姿势(Nguyen, Le和La 2025). 这些系统显示2D自动化,但在输出宽度、捕获计数、可移植性、环境控制以及专用钻机的使用方面各不相同。

blocks.en: 3 System Design and Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 系统设计和方法

blocks.en: Capture-to-Measurement Workflow. Figure 1 presents the capture-to-measurement workflow. Panel (a) shows the aisafehand mobile app used to acquire the required hand-on-paper image. Perspective rectification (PR) uses the recovered paper quadrilateral to produce a fronto-parallel view, correcting projective distortion and providing the geometric reference for metric scaling (b). Background whitening (BW) sets non-hand pixels to white, reducing interference from variable shadows around the hand and between the fingers (c). A YOLO landmark predictor produces 41 initial anthropometry-specific landmarks (d); geometry-constrained post-processing (PP) refines them using finger geometry and contour evidence (e); and the app visualizes the resulting 44 predicted dimensions (f).

blocks.en: Fixed prompt coordinates for mask segmentation are unsuitable because the location and scale of the hand within the image, as well as its placement on the paper, vary across captures. In the PR stage, HandAnthro derives image-adaptive SAM-HQ prompts from the 21 hand-pose landmarks returned by MediaPipe Hands ( Zhang et al. 2020 ) . These auxiliary hand-pose landmarks provide coarse hand-location and scale cues for prompt placement. Appendix documents the evaluated adaptive prompt construction.
blocks.zh: 用于面具分解的固定的即时坐标不合适,因为图像中手的位置和大小,以及放在纸张上,各捕捉方式不同. 在PR阶段,HandAnthro从MediaPipe Hands(Zhang等人,2020年)返回的21个手持式地标上获得了适应图像的SAM-HQ提示. 这些辅助手持式地标为迅速放置提供了粗糙的手动位置和比例提示. 附录记录了经过评估的适应性快速构造。

blocks.en: The raw hand mask is dilated once with a 31 × 31 31\times 31 square kernel so that the inpainting region fully covers the portion of the paper occluded by the hand and wrist (Fig. 2 (d)). The dilated mask is then polarity-converted so that its white foreground identifies the region supplied to LaMa ( Suvorov et al. 2022 ) for inpainting (Fig. 2 (e)). LaMa completes the hand-shaped interruption in the paper-mask representation, producing a recovered paper mask (Fig. 2 (f)).
blocks.zh: 生手面具一次用31×3131\时的31平方内核膨胀,使印染区域完全覆盖手腕所覆盖的纸张部分(图2(d)). 膨胀的面罩再进行极性转换,使其白色前缘能够识别提供给LaMa(Suvorov等人,2022年)用于涂漆的区域(图2(e))。 LaMa完成纸浆代表的手形中断,产生回收的纸面面具(图2(f)).

blocks.en: The completed paper mask (Fig. 2 (f)) is used to detect the paper quadrilateral and its four corners. The detected quadrilateral is overlaid on the original red-green-blue (RGB) image for visualization (Fig. 2 (g)). Matching the four detected source corners to the corresponding corners of an ideal rectangle with the known paper aspect ratio determines the homography 𝐇 \mathbf{H} . Applying 𝐇 \mathbf{H} to the original RGB image produces the perspective-rectified image (Fig. 2 (h)).
blocks.zh: 完整的纸面罩(图2(f))用于探测纸的四边形及其四个角. 探测到的四边形在原红绿蓝(RGB)图像上覆盖,用于可视化(图2(g)). 将四个被检测到的源角与理想矩形的相应角相匹配,与已知的纸面比值决定了图谱H\mathbf{H}. 将 H\ mathbf{H} 应用到原始的 RGB 图像中, 会产生透视校正的图像 (图 2 (h)) 。

blocks.en: Background Whitening and Anthropometry-Specific Landmarks. HandAnthro reuses the raw, undilated hand mask produced during PR (Fig. 2 (c)). The same homography 𝐇 \mathbf{H} warps the original RGB image and the raw hand mask into the rectified frame, preserving their pixel correspondence. In the rectified image (Fig. 2 (h)), BW retains RGB values inside the warped hand mask and sets all pixels outside it to white. This removes non-hand pixels, including shadows, strengthening the contour evidence without a second segmentation inference (Appendix ). The background-whitened image is resized to a canonical 720 × 932 720\times 932 -pixel frame and passed to the YOLO predictor.
blocks.zh: 背景 怀特宁与人类-特定地标. HandAnthro重复使用PR(图2(c))。 同名的传记 H\ mathbf{H} 将原始的 RGB 图像和原始的手面具曲解到修正框中, 保留了它们的像素对应 。 在修正的图像(图2(h))中,BW在被扭曲的手罩内保留了RGB值,并将其外置的所有像素设置为白色. 这可以去除非手像素,包括阴影,加强轮廓证据而无需二次分解推论(Appendix ). 背景白的图像被调整为犬形720×932 720\times 932 - 像素框架,并传递给YOLO预测器.

blocks.en: We define and annotate 41 anthropometry-specific landmarks spanning the thumb, four fingers, inter-finger roots, palm, and wrist (Appendix ). The final predictor is a YOLOv11x-pose model ( Jocher and Qiu 2024 ) fine-tuned with augmentation on background-whitened images using this landmark schema; Section 4 describes the evaluated model configurations.
blocks.zh: 我们定义并注释了41个人类测量的地标,它们跨越拇指,四指,指间根,掌和腕(附录). 最终的预测器是YOLOv11x-pose模型(Jocher和Quu 2024),利用这一标志性方案在背景白图像上进行增量的微调;第4节描述了被评价的模型配置.

blocks.en: Geometry-Constrained Refinement. PP refines the anatomical placement of measurement endpoints. Initial YOLO finger landmarks can misalign with the finger’s orientation and length. PP uses MediaPipe hand-pose landmarks and the hand contour from the background-whitened image to estimate each finger’s axis. A forward search from the finger centerline along this axis locates a corrected fingertip on the contour.
blocks.zh: 几何-约束完善. PP改进了测量终点的解剖定位。 最初的YOLO指标可以与指向和长度错配. PP 使用 MediaPipe 手持地标和背景白图像的手轮廓来估计每个手指的轴. 沿着这个轴线从指中线进行前向搜索,在轮廓上找到一个纠正的指尖.

blocks.en: For each finger, PP holds the YOLO-predicted root fixed and compares the predicted and corrected root-to-tip vectors (Fig. 3 ). Their angular difference defines the rotation θ \theta , and their length ratio L c / L YOLO L_{c}/L_{\mathrm{YOLO}} defines the scale factor. PP applies this rotation and scaling to the finger’s configured landmark group, then aligns eligible lateral endpoints with the hand boundary along their measurement directions (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 对于每个手指,PP持有YOLO预测的根固定,并比较预测和校正的根对尖向量(图3 ). 他们的角差定义了旋转 \\theta ,他们的长度比 L c / L YOLO L_{c / L_{\ mathrm{ YOLO } 定义了比例系数. PP 将这种旋转和缩放应用到手指所配置的地标组,然后沿着其测量方向(Appendix )将符合条件的横向端点与手边对齐.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 试验和评价

blocks.en: YOLO Fine-Tuning and Ablation Design. The model-development dataset comprised one annotated palmar image from each of 42 independent participants. The participants were randomly assigned to mutually exclusive training and validation sets comprising 33 and 9 images, respectively. The 45 participants in the controlled test set were held out from both sets, with no participant overlap. To isolate the incremental contributions of PR, BW, and PP, we evaluated four progressively constructed pipeline configurations. In ablation case A0 , YOLO was fine-tuned on the original captured images. In A1 , YOLO was fine-tuned on perspective-rectified images. In A2 , YOLO was fine-tuned on images processed by both PR and BW. A3 then applied PP to the corresponding A2 predictions. Each configuration was evaluated using two pose backbones (YOLOv8x-pose ( Jocher, Chaurasia, and Qiu 2023 ) and YOLOv11x-pose) and two training data augmentation settings (with and without augmentation), yielding 4 × 2 × 2 = 16 4\times 2\times 2=16 experiments (see Appendices and for details).
blocks.zh: YOLO Fine-Tuning and oblication Design. (原始内容存档于2018-09-29). 模型开发数据集包括42名独立参与者每人的一张带注释的Palmar图像。 与会者被随机分配到由33幅和9幅图像组成的相互排斥的培训和鉴定集。 受控测试组的45名参与者来自两组,没有参与者重叠。 为了孤立PR、BW和PP的增量贡献,我们评价了四个逐步建造的管道配置。 在A0案上,YOLO在最初捕获的图像上进行了微调. 在A1中,YOLO在透视校正图像上进行了微调. 在A2中,YOLO在PR和BW处理的图像上进行了微调. A3随后将PP应用于相应的A2预测. 每个配置都使用两个姿势骨干(YOLOv8x-pose(Jocher,Chaurasia,和Quu 2023))和YOLOv11x-pose)以及两个训练数据增强设置(有和没有增强)来评价,生成4×2×2=16 4\times 2\times 2=16实验(参见附录和细节).

blocks.en: Controlled Repeated-Capture Evaluation. The controlled test set comprised 45 held-out participants, each contributing 16 palmar captures spanning all combinations of two smartphones, two backgrounds, two capture angles, and two nominal illumination settings (720 images). We evaluated PR and end-to-end completion over all 720 inputs. The two nominal illumination settings produced little visible difference in brightness in the captured images, as the smartphones’ built-in automatic exposure and image processing adjusted image brightness across conditions. We therefore pooled the two settings and did not assess illumination effects separately. Capture examples and rig geometry are shown in Appendices and .
blocks.zh: 受控重复能力评价. 受控测试集由45名被搁置的参与者组成,每个参与者贡献16个帕玛捕捉器,覆盖两个智能手机,两个背景,两个捕捉角度,以及两个名义上的照明设置(720个图像)的所有组合. 我们评估了所有720项投入的公关和端到端完成情况。 两种名义上的照明设置在捕获的图像的亮度上几乎没有明显区别,因为智能手机的内置自动曝光和图像处理在各种条件下调整了图像亮度. 因此,我们集中了这两种环境,没有分别评估照明效应。 捕捉实例和钻机几何在附录和.

blocks.en: Two trained operators independently measured all 44 dimensions of each participant’s hand using calipers; their mean served as the reference for each dimension (Appendix ). Automated measurement accuracy was evaluated on the 704 complete outputs. We first calculated each dimension’s MAE across these images, then averaged the 44 dimension-specific MAEs to obtain overall MAE. Regional MAEs used the same aggregation within the thumb (D1–D5), four non-thumb fingers (D6–D33), and palm and wrist (D34–D44).
blocks.zh: 两名训练有素的操作员使用卡利佩斯独立测量了每个参与者手的所有44个维度;其平均值作为每个维度的参考(附录)。 对704项完整产出进行了自动化测量准确性评价。 我们首先通过这些图像计算出每个维度的MAE, 然后平均计算出44个维度特定的MAE, 以获得总体的MAE. 区域主要经济实体在拇指(D1-D5)、四个非拇指(D6-D33)和手掌和手腕(D34-D44)中使用了同样的组合。

blocks.en: For capture-condition accuracy, we calculated each dimension’s MAE separately for each smartphone, background, and angle setting, then averaged across the 44 dimensions (Appendix ). For stability, we calculated the standard deviation (SD) of each participant’s predictions for each dimension across completed captures. For each participant and dimension, we also calculated the absolute difference between the mean predictions at the two levels of each factor, then averaged these differences across participants and dimensions (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 为了捕捉条件的准确性,我们分别计算了每个智能手机、背景和角度设定的每个维度的MAE,然后在44维之间进行平均计算(附录)。 为了稳定起见,我们计算了每个参与者对完成捕获的每个维度所作的预测的标准偏差。 对于每个参与者和维度,我们还计算了每个因数两个层次的平均预测值的绝对差,然后对参与者和维度的这些差异进行平均值(附录 ).

blocks.en: For landmark-based evaluation, we selected one image per participant from the 704 complete captures, aiming for balanced representation across the eight smartphone–background–angle combinations. The 41 landmarks were manually annotated on each selected image after PR and BW. We report the mean Euclidean pixel error across the 45 × 41 45\times 41 predicted–reference landmark pairs. From these same annotations, we derived all 44 dimensions, then compared them with the same caliper reference. This annotation-to-caliper diagnostic comprised 1,980 image–dimension comparisons and was reported separately from the 704-image automated evaluation (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 为了进行划时代的评估,我们从704个完整的捕捉点中选择了每个参与者一个图像,目的是在8个智能手机-背景-角组合中实现均衡的代表性。 41个地标在公关和BW之后的每个选定的图像上被手动注释. 我们报告平均Euclidean像素误差, 从这些相同的说明中,我们得出了所有的44维,然后将它们与同样的卡利珀参照物进行比较. 这种注解-caliper诊断包括1,980个图像-二元比较,与704图像自动评价(附录)分开报告。

blocks.en: Stage-Level Baseline Comparisons. We restricted stage-level baselines to alternatives that produced directly comparable outputs at the evaluated pipeline stage. Canny–Hough perspective rectification (CH-PR), our baseline using Canny edge detection and probabilistic Hough line detection ( Canny 1986 ; Matas, Galambos, and Kittler 2000 ) , replaced HandAnthro’s complete PR module and was evaluated for completion over all 720 controlled captures; its measurement-error comparison used the 406 captures completed by both pipelines (Appendix ). For the BW baselines, we separately substituted REMBG ( Gatis 2025 ) , BackgroundRemover ( Nader 2025 ) , or CarveKit ( Selin 2024 ) to process the 704 captures for which HandAnthro completed PR, while holding PR, landmark prediction, and PP fixed. End-to-end measurement error for each BW variant was calculated on that variant’s complete outputs; BW-stage runtime was also measured. Section 5.1 reports these comparisons.
blocks.zh: 阶段基线比较。 我们把阶段基线限于在评估的管道阶段产生直接可比产出的替代品。 Canny-Hough视角校正(CH-PR),我们使用Canny边缘探测和概率Hough线探测的基线(Canny 1986;Matas,Galambos,和Kittler 2000),取代了HandAnthro完整的PR模块,并被评价完成所有720个可控捕获;其测量-误差比较使用了两个管道完成的406个捕获(附录). 对于BW基线,我们分别替换REMBG(Gatis 2025),背景Remover(Nader 2025),或CarveKit(Selin 2024)处理汉德安特罗完成PR的704捕获,同时持有PR,标志性预测,PP固定. 每个生物武器变体的端到端测量误差均根据该变体的完整输出计算;还测量了生物武器阶段的运行时间。 第5.1节报告了这些比较。

blocks.en: Researcher-Assisted Field Pilot. At multiple professional events for firefighters, staff assisted with app operation, hand placement, and photography for the field pilot. The cohort comprised 268 firefighters (204 male, 64 female), each with one retained dominant-hand palmar image. Unsuitable photographs were discarded and retaken. Retained images underwent automated batch processing on a laboratory desktop without human intervention. All completed outputs were included in the analysis without human correction (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-10-12). Research-Assisted Field Pilot. 在为消防员举办的多个专业活动中,工作人员为外地飞行员协助应用操作、手插和摄影。 这批人共有268名消防员(204名男性,64名女性),每名消防员中有一名保持了占支配地位的掌上型形象。 丢弃和重新拍摄了不合适的照片。 在实验室桌面上对留存的图像进行了自动批处理,没有人类干预。 所有已完成的产出都包括在分析中,没有经过人的更正(附录)。

blocks.en: Processing completion was defined as returning all 44 dimensions and was evaluated over the 268 retained images. Sex-specific means for 14 dimensions were compared with published summaries from an independent national firefighter cohort ( Hsiao et al. 2015 ) , yielding 28 contrasts. This comparison assessed population-level plausibility.
blocks.zh: 处理完成被定义为返回所有44个维度,并对保留的268个图像进行了评价。 将14个维度的性别专用手段与独立的全国消防队(Hsiao等人,2015年)公布的摘要相比较,形成了28个对比。 这一比较评估了人口层面的合理性。

blocks.en: All failures occurred during PR (16/720 controlled; 8/268 field), and every PR-complete capture yielded all 44 measurements. Post-hoc review associated every controlled failure with wrist placement at or beyond a paper edge. Five field failures involved hands placed too high or low, with adaptive paper prompts outside the sheet. The remaining field failures involved incomplete paper framing, a hand extending beyond the sheet, or a covered corner (Appendix ).

anatomical landmark placement and support users’ visual

blocks.en: The capture-condition analyses describe both agreement with calipers and the stability of predictions for the same person. Across the tested settings, average within-person prediction changes were larger for angle than for smartphone or background (Fig. 5 (b)). This pattern motivates clearer capture-angle guidance and evaluation of whether such guidance improves measurement consistency.
blocks.zh: 捕捉条件分析既描述了与哈里发的一致,也描述了同一人的预测稳定性. 在整个经过测试的设置中,人内部的平均预测变化角度大于智能手机或背景(图5(b))。 这种模式促使人们更清楚地掌握和评价这种指导是否改善了衡量的一致性。

blocks.en: The trained operator estimated that it would take about 15 minutes to measure all 44 dimensions of one hand with calipers. Once a photograph was available, HandAnthro extracted 44 projected dimensions with mean processing times of about 4 seconds on an NVIDIA RTX 4000 Ada graphics processing unit (GPU) and 26 seconds on an Apple M3 processor. These processing times exclude image collection. A smartphone and letter-size paper suffice for image capture, while automated extraction removes the need for manual landmark placement or for a trained operator to measure each dimension with calipers. Together, the simple capture requirements and short processing times offer potential for collecting hand anthropometric data from larger populations.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的操作员估计,用卡利佩斯测量一只手的所有44个维度需要约15分钟. 一旦有照片,汉德安特罗在NVIDIA RTX 4000 Ada图形处理单元(GPU)上提取了44个预测维度,平均处理时间约为4秒,在苹果M3处理器上提取了26秒. 这些处理时间不包括图像收集. 智能手机和字母大小的纸张足以捕捉图像,而自动提取则可以消除手动地标定位或训练有素的操作员用卡利佩斯测量每个维度的需要. 简单的捕获要求和较短的处理时间加在一起,有可能从更多的人群中收集人工人体测量数据。

blocks.en: Evaluation is limited to 45 controlled participants and a researcher-assisted field cohort without matched caliper measurements. Generalization to unassisted capture, additional devices, sites, and occupational domains remains to be evaluated.
blocks.zh: 评价仅限于45名受控参与者和研究人员协助的现场组别,没有相应的卡利佩测量。 尚未对无辅助捕获、其他装置、场地和职业领域的普遍化进行评估。

blocks.en: Building on these results, we will evaluate unassisted app use, retaining all captures to assess attempts per user, guidance adherence, and completion rates overall and among compliant images. Planned AWS GPU inference will return measurements or recapture feedback, with response time and prediction quality evaluated. Pilot participants’ concerns about fingerprint exposure in submitted palmar images motivate future evaluation of dorsal images as an alternative input for hand anthropometry. To address dimension-dependent biases, particularly in palm and wrist measurements, we will investigate offset and scale corrections using paired image-derived and caliper measurements, comparing shared and occupation-specific calibration on independent participants.
blocks.zh: 在这些结果的基础上,我们将评估非辅助应用的使用情况,保留所有捕获量,以评估每个用户的尝试,遵守指导,以及总体完成率和符合要求的图像。 计划中的AWS GPU推论将返回测量或重新获得反馈,并评估反应时间和预测质量。 试点参与者对所提交的棕榈树图象中指纹曝光的担忧,促使今后对遗迹图象进行评价,以此作为手力人体测量的替代输入。 为了解决依赖维度的偏差,特别是在棕榈和手腕测量方面的偏差,我们将利用配对图像和卡路里测量来调查抵消和缩小校正范围,对独立参与者的共享和特定职业校准进行比较。

blocks.en: I.1 Canny–Hough Perspective Rectification (CH-PR)
blocks.zh: I.1 罐头-硬透视修正(CH-PR)

blocks.en: We implement a fully automatic, learning-free baseline for paper rectification using edge and line geometry. Given an input image, we compute a Canny edge map ( Canny 1986 ) and extract line segments via the probabilistic Hough transform ( Matas, Galambos, and Kittler 2000 ) (OpenCV HoughLinesP ). Segments are clustered into two dominant orientation groups and assigned to the four paper sides, and each side line is fitted from its supporting segments. We select the candidate with maximal edge support on the Canny map. Paper corners are computed from intersections of adjacent side lines, and the quadrilateral is required to be convex. The image is then warped to a canonical rectangle via homography.
blocks.zh: 我们采用边缘和线状几何来实施一个完全自动、无学习的纸张校正基线。 根据输入图像,我们计算一个坎尼边缘图(Canny 1986),并通过概率霍夫变换(Matas, Galambos, 和 Kittler 2000)(OpenCV HoughLinesP)提取线段. 片段被组合成两个主方向组,并分配给四个纸面,每个侧线都从它的辅助片段安装. 我们在坎尼地图上选择最有优势支持的候选人 纸角从相邻侧线的交叉点计算,四方形需要为凸角. 图像随后通过人谱学被扭曲为犬形矩形.

blocks.en: On the 720-image test set, CH-PR returned 412 convex, warpable quadrilaterals (57.2%), with downstream processing completed for all corresponding captures. MAE on the 406 captures completed by both pipelines was 10.68 mm for CH-PR and 3.66 mm for HandAnthro. The 308 non-warpable cases comprised 266 without two orthogonal line groups, 32 with non-convex side-line intersections, and 10 with an unrecoverable missing side.
blocks.zh: 在720-图像测试集上,CH-PR返回了412个对流,可曲速四边形(57.2%),下游加工完成,用于所有相应的捕获. 两条管道完成的406次捕获的MAE,CH-PR为10.68毫米,HandAnthro为3.66毫米. 308件非保税案件包括266件没有正交线组,32件有非交汇线侧线交叉,10件有无法恢复的缺失侧.

blocks.en: I.2 Background Removal Baselines (REMBG, BackgroundRemover, and CarveKit)
blocks.zh: 一.2 背景清除基线(REMBG、背景记忆和CarveKit)

blocks.en: To evaluate the accuracy and computational efficiency of our BW module, we compare it with REMBG ( Gatis 2025 ) , BackgroundRemover ( Nader 2025 ) , and CarveKit ( Selin 2024 ) under identical PR, landmark-prediction, and PP stages. Table S4 reports end-to-end dimension MAE and BW-only runtime, while Fig. S8 shows representative mask behavior under inter-finger shadows. Every variant produced complete outputs for all 704 PR-complete captures.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的BW模块的准确性和计算效率,我们将它与REMBG(Gatis 2025),背景Remover(Nader 2025),以及CarveKit(Selin 2024)在相同的PR,里程碑预测和PP阶段进行对比. 表S4报告端到端的维度MAE和BW只运行时间,而Fig. S8显示在指间阴影下的代表性面具行为. 每个变体都为全部704 PR完成捕获提供了完整的输出.

blocks.en: As an architectural fairness check, forcing our BW to run from scratch on each rectified image without reusing the PR-stage hand mask took 1213 ms per image on the same NVIDIA RTX 4000 Ada Generation GPU, compared with 93 ms for REMBG. The production advantage therefore comes from mask reuse rather than a faster standalone segmentation model.

blocks.en: We compare sex-specific field-cohort summaries with Hsiao et al.’s independent national firefighter reference ( Hsiao et al. 2015 ) . This unpaired comparison evaluates group-level plausibility, not individual accuracy or agreement.
blocks.zh: 与Hsiao等人的独立国家消防员参考(Hsiao等人,2015年)相比, 这种未经认证的比较评价了团体层面的可信度,而不是个人的准确性或协议.

blocks.en: The field cohort included 268 firefighters with one retained dominant-hand palmar image and a demographic record linked a priori (204 male, 64 female). Unlinked captures were excluded before processing, independently of algorithm outcome. Staff assisted with placement, app operation, and photography; unsuitable images were retaken, but attempt counts were not recorded. Retrospective desktop processing returned all 44 dimensions for 260 cases (97.0%; 197 male, 63 female). Visual review of landmark overlays did not change coordinates, trigger recomputation, or exclude completed outputs. Hsiao et al.’s Table 2 reports means and SDs for 14 dimensions from 855 men and 88 women, measured on right-hand 2D flatbed scans with fingers open.
blocks.zh: 外地组群包括268名消防员,其中一人保留了占支配地位的Palmar形象,人口记录与先验(204名男性,64名女性)有关。 与算法结果无关的捕获在处理前被排除. 工作人员在安插、应用和摄影方面得到协助;重新拍摄了不适当的图像,但没有记录企图的计数。 追溯式桌面处理返回了260个案件的所有44维(97.0%;197个男性,63个女性)。 对地标覆盖物的视觉审查没有改变坐标,触发重算,或排除已完成的产出。 萧等人 表2显示855名男子和88名妇女的14个维度和SD,用手指打开的右手2D平板扫描测量。

blocks.en: The independent cohorts differ in recruitment, year, hand laterality (dominant versus right), and measurement protocol; palm breadth also uses a proxy. Their offsets cannot separate measurement effects from cohort differences. Reference summaries permit comparison of means and SDs only; statistical significance does not establish agreement.
blocks.zh: 独立组别在征聘、年份、手的后期性(主要相对于右侧)和测量规程方面各不相同;棕榈宽度也使用代用。 它们的抵消不能将衡量效应与组别差异分开。 参考摘要只允许对手段和自毁数据进行比较;统计意义不能确立协议。

blocks.en: PR and end-to-end completion were both 704/720 (97.8%): every rectified capture returned all 44 dimensions. Accuracy uses these 704 captures, with no imputed errors for the 16 failures.

blocks.en: Visual review of all 16 PR failures found the wrist crease on or beyond a paper edge: 15 hands crossed a long edge and one sat low on the bottom edge. One or both lower paper prompts fell outside the sheet, the paper mask included background, and no valid quadrilateral was recovered. The complete sheet was visible in every failed frame. These failures involved seven participants (4, 4, 3, 2, 1, 1, and 1 captures); three of these participants had failures with both smartphones.
blocks.zh: 所有16个PR故障的视觉回顾发现手腕折叠在或超过一个纸边:15只手越过一个长边,1只手在底边坐低. 一张或两张下纸的提示都落在工作表之外,纸面面具包括背景,没有找到有效的四边形. 完整的工作表在每个失败的框架中可见 。 这些失败涉及7名参与者(4,4,3,2,1,1和1名抓获);其中3名参与者在两个智能手机上都有失败.

blocks.en: All eight incomplete field captures failed during PR. Post-hoc review found five hands placed too high or low, with adaptive prompts outside the sheet; one incompletely framed sheet; one hand extending beyond the paper; and one covered paper corner.
blocks.zh: PR期间所有8个不完整的字段抓取失败. 事后审查发现,有五只手放得太高或太低,床单外有适应性提示;一只没有完整框架的床单;一只手伸到纸张之外;一个覆盖的纸角。
